result.topic_en: Draft notes on the coefficients of expansions of functions of the P-function type (Riemann's hypergeometric-type functions) near branch points, on how the constants depend on the branching values, on the special case in which the functions reduce to simpler ones, and on applying the result to integrals of algebraic functions and to the integration of linear differential equations.
